title: MoonMail
summary: Encrypted Ootle letters and postboxes. November 11, 2026: the MoonMail template is published on mainnet, but the current app reports Mainnet office pending and the public post office unavailable. No live mail operation was verified. Wallet private-view access is an account-wide permission; spending requires separate approval. Public postbox identities, timing and fees remain observable. The retained October recording covers documentation, not current delivery.
cardSummary: Explore encrypted Ootle letters and postboxes. The mainnet post office is pending; live mail is unavailable.
